summary: Gamehaus Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing notices and proxy statements for an extraordinary general meeting of holders of Class A ordinary shares to be held July 10, 2026. The meeting will consider two proposals: a voting rights variation increasing Class B share votes from 15 to 50, and an adjournment proposal if needed. The board unanimously recommends voting for the proposals. This is a routine governance matter—no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved.
